about: Hand audit of EVERY snip the new ladder showed on the 82 reachable swarm sites, junk/clean by the two hand questions (dominated by chrome? opens with a chrome run?). Audit 1 was read on the output of the first complete version of the gate (wall check, content region, junk gate, lexicon CHROME as frozen plus the waiting-room wall phrases) BEFORE the prose-run rule, the STRONG phrase list, the fragment rule and the link-sentence rule existed. The final audit was read after them, on the same sites, so it is IN-SAMPLE for those four changes (the changes were chosen after reading audit 1). 'mixed' = content with a promo or credit line inside it, not leading and not dominating. The fresh check (eval/swarm/fresh-check.json) is the only out-of-sample part.

notJunkButNotContent: blog#2|c,d (the post's own JSX code, shown as text)

junkByHand: legal#2|t (a table of contents: 'Section / What can you find there?')
withTablesAndCode (not in the bars).judgeNote: the frozen judge reads prose; rows and code are flagged by it (stopless runs)

junkSitesByHand: allrecipes (c opens with the site's 'Test Kitchen staff' blurb)
fresh.note: n=4 reachable: 1 junk site by hand = 25%; one fresh sample is too small to carry a rate
